title: Tokenize text and compute deterministic statistics
prompt: Implement tokenize in src/tokenize.js and analyzeText in src/stats.js, then re-export both functions from src/index.js. Use ES modules and only Node built-ins. tokenize(text) must require a string (otherwise throw an Error), lowercase it, and return all maximal runs of Unicode letters or Unicode numbers as an array of lowercase tokens; punctuation, apostrophes, hyphens, and whitespace separate tokens, and an input with no tokens returns []. analyzeText(text, options = {}) must validate its arguments and return exactly { characters, charactersNoWhitespace, words, uniqueWords, sentences, topWords }. characters is the number of Unicode code points using Array.from; charactersNoWhitespace counts code points that do not match the whitespace class \s; words is the token count; uniqueWords counts distinct tokens. sentences is the number of non-empty trimmed pieces after splitting the original text on runs of '.', '!' or '?'; punctuation-only or empty text therefore has zero sentences. options.limit is a non-negative safe integer with default 3. topWords contains up to limit entries { word, count } for distinct tokens, sorted by descending count and then by ascending Unicode code-unit order of word; limit 0 returns []. Reject non-string text, non-object options, and invalid limits with an Error. Do not mutate inputs.
